c.desc: 12 yr, $209.3M (2023-34), 2030-34 player options; conditional club options after 2029 (8 or 10 years)
c.note: Rodríguez's club option, decided upon after 2028, is based on MVP vote finishes from 2022-2028. As of the end of the 2025 season, Rodríguez has been in the top ten of voting three times, which currently makes his club option eight years and $240 million. With one further top-ten finish, the club option would increase to eight years and $260 million. With one MVP award or two more top-five finishes joining his top-five finish in 2023, the option would be eight years and $280 million. If he wins two MVPs or is in the top five three further times, the option would be 10 years for $350 million. If the option is declined, there is a mutual option for seven years and $168 million decided upon at the end of the 2029 season.
